newsitem.title: CHINA: China area under beans down 6.5 pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: China area under beans down 6.5 pct in 1996.

text.p: China's area of land under bean cultivation, including soybean and green beans, is 10.5 million hectares in 1996, down by 6.5 percent or 721,000 hectares compared with 1995, the Futures Herald said on Monday.
The area under soybean was 7.42 million hectares, down by 8.6 percent or 705,000 hectares from last year, the newspaper quoted the State Statistical Bureau as saying.
The area under green beans was 754,000 hectares, a reduction of 4.0 percent or 31,300 hectares, it said.
The newspaper attributed the drop in the acreage planted to the poor production returns that discourged farmers from planting beans, it said.
China's soybean output is expected to reach 14 million tonnes in 1996, while domestic demand was expected at around 14.81 million tonnes, an earlier report said.
